scope: 通用广告/消费者保护 + 商品说明与标签 + 小家电/3C 数码 BSTI 强制认证 + 价格与计量 + 销售合同默示条件；不含食品/美妆/玩具、支付/物流/退换（Layer 3）
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示法条与页面事实同时成立时可给规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判‘需要证明’；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得以虚假或不实广告欺骗买家以销售商品或服务；是否构成欺骗取决于广告整体语境与可核对事实。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与截图（含上下文）；可核对事实（材质、容量、功率、认证、价格、产地）需规格书、检测报告、授权书或价格记录；语境判断需人工复核。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 200,000，或两者并罚（s.44）。罚则为上限，不代表必然处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person deceives any buyer by any false or untrue advertisement for the purpose of selling any goods or service, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 2 (two) lacs, or with both.
rules.notes: CRPA 是孟加拉国消费者保护的主法；s.44 是虚假广告的核心刑事条款。英文引文来自 2014 年官方 Authentic English Text（SRO 08-Law/2014）。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得制造或生产假冒商品；‘fake’指未经授权仿制已授权上市的商品，不论仿制品是否具备原商品的属性、成分、要素或品质。
rules.evidence_needed: 品牌授权书/商标注册、采购链、正品鉴别报告、海关或执法记录；页面出现 replica/first copy 等词仅为线索，需与品牌方核实。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 3 年或罚金 Taka 200,000，或两者并罚（s.50）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person makes or manufactures fake goods, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 (three) years, or with fine not exceeding Taka 2 (two) lacs, or with both.
rules.notes: s.50 针对制造/生产假冒商品；销售假冒商品的刑事路径还可能涉及其他法律，本库未展开。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 若其他法律或规则要求商品以包装销售并在标签上载明重量、数量、成分、使用说明、最高零售价、生产日期、包装日期、有效期，则违反该义务可依 s.37 处罚；本条不自行创设标签字段义务。
rules.evidence_needed: 实物包装/标签照片、适用法律或标准下的字段清单、供应商声明；仅凭网页未展示标签不能认定不符合。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.37）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person violates any obligation, imposed by any Act or rules, of selling any goods within cover and inscribing weight, amount, ingredients, instructions for use, maximum, retail; price, date of manufacture, date of packaging and date of expiry of that goods on the label, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: s.37 是罚则条款，前置义务来自其他 Act/rules；对非食品小家电/3C，前置标签规则主要在 BSTI 标准与 Import Policy Order（后者英文文本未取得）。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 若法律或规则要求以显著方式张贴商品价目表，违反者可依 s.38 处罚；线上销售页是否清晰展示价格与附加费用可作为观察线索。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面截图、价格字段、运费/手续费/税费是否在结算前披露；适用价格规则文本。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.38）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person violates any obligation, imposed by any Act or rules, of displaying the price-list of goods by affixing it at a conspicuous place of his shop or organization, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 把线上页面等同于‘shop’存在解释空间；报告应写‘页面未展示/展示不清’，不直接下结论。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得以高于法律或规则固定价格的价格销售或要约销售商品；仅在存在法定固定价时适用。
rules.evidence_needed: 法定价格通知/公报、页面价格、发票、价格标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.40）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person sells or offers to sell any goods, medicine or service at a price higher than the price fixed under any Act or rules, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 小家电/3C 通常没有法定固定价；此条主要用于有价格管制的品类。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得在收取对价后不销售或不适当交付所承诺的商品或服务。
rules.evidence_needed: 订单、付款记录、承诺交付时间、物流/客服记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.45）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person does not sell or deliver properly any goods or service promised in consideration of money, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 需要交易与履约证据，单看页面不能判定。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 销售或供应商品时，交付重量不得少于向消费者要约的重量。
rules.evidence_needed: 标称重量、实测重量、包装规格、计量器具校准记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.46）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person sells or supplies any goods to consumer less than the offered weight, at the time of supplying or selling, he shall be punished with imprisonment for not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 需实测；页面标注净重只是线索。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 销售或交付商品时，交付数量/尺寸不得少于向消费者承诺的测量值。
rules.evidence_needed: 标称尺寸/容量、实测、规格书。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.48）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person sells or delivers any goods to the consumer less than the offered measurement at the time of delivering or selling, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 需实测；不要把‘英寸’等英制标注本身当作违规。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得销售或要约销售已过期的商品或药品。
rules.evidence_needed: 包装日期照片、批次、库存/进货记录；页面日期与实物标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 1 年或罚金 Taka 50,000，或两者并罚（s.51）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person sells or offers to sell any date expired goods or medicine, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 1 (one) year, or with fine not exceeding Taka 50 (fifty) thousands, or with both.
rules.notes: 小家电/3C 通常无保质期，但电池、耗材、赠品可能有；不要对无保质期商品套用。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得以被其他法律或规则禁止、且危害人的生命或健康的工艺制造或加工商品。
rules.evidence_needed: 工艺说明、检测报告（迁移/重金属/微生物）、适用禁令文本；声称本身不等于工艺被禁止。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 2 年或罚金 Taka 100,000，或两者并罚（s.43）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person manufactures or processes any goods in a process which is injurious to human life or health and prohibited under any Act or rules, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2 (two) years, or with fine not exceeding Taka 1 (one) lac, or with both.
rules.notes: 需要先确定具体禁令；本条不能单独作为‘工艺不安全’的结论。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 不得违反其他法律或规则的禁令，实施危害服务接受者（service receiver）生命或安全的行为；条文使用‘service receiver’，对纯商品购买者的适用需结合具体交易/服务结构判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 安全测试报告、认证证书、事故/召回记录、适用禁令；以及该交易是否构成条文所称的‘service’的证据。
rules.penalty_or_note: 最高：监禁 3 年或罚金 Taka 200,000，或两者并罚（s.52）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person, in violation of any prohibition imposed under any Act or rules, does any act which is detrimental to the life or security of any service receiver, he shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 (three) years, or with fine not exceeding Taka 2 (two) lacs, or with both.
rules.notes: s.52 的 ‘service receiver’ 可能不覆盖纯商品买卖；用于商品页时只作风险线索，适用性需律师判断。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 因本法所列罪行被定罪后再次实施同一罪行的，按该罪行最高刑罚的两倍处罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 前次定罪判决、案号。
rules.penalty_or_note: 两倍法定最高刑（s.55）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If any person convicted of any offence mentioned in this Act does the same offence again, he shall be punished with twice the maximum punishment provided for that offence.
rules.notes: 不适用于首次违规；报告不应假设存在前科。

rules.law_name: The Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 (Act No. 26 of 2009) 消费者权益保护法 2009
rules.requirement: 法院可酌情在刑罚之外，命令将与罪行相关的非法商品、制造原料、材料等没收归国家。
rules.evidence_needed: 扣押清单、法院命令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: If the court thinks fit, it may, in addition to the punishment provided in the foregoing sections of this Chapter, pass an order to forfeit the illegal goods of manufacturing ingredients, materials etc. related to the offence in favour of the State.

rules.law_name: The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No. XXXVII of 1985) 孟加拉国标准与检验机构法令 1985
rules.requirement: 除依第 20 条取得的许可证外，任何人不得在商品、工艺、专利名称、商标或外观设计上使用 BSTI 标准标志或其可混淆的仿冒标志。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、授权范围、标签/包装照片；页面出现 b mark/BSTI logo 需核实授权。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.19/s.21/s.22：最高监禁 2 年或罚金 Taka 50,000（最低 Taka 7,000），或两者并罚（s.30(1)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Except under a licence granted under section 20, no person shall use in relation to any article or process or in the title of any patent, or in any trade mark or design, the Standard Mark or any colourable imitation thereof.
rules.notes: 法令曾被最高法院宣告无效，后由 2013 年第 7 号 Act 追认生效；引用时保留该背景。标准标志的使用许可与产品认证是两件事，需核对许可证范围。

rules.law_name: The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No. XXXVII of 1985) 孟加拉国标准与检验机构法令 1985
rules.requirement: 即使已取得许可证，商品或工艺不符合相应孟加拉国标准（BDS）时，仍不得使用标准标志或其仿冒标志。
rules.evidence_needed: BDS 标准号、检测报告、CM 许可证、生产一致性记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.19：最高监禁 2 年或罚金 Taka 50,000（最低 Taka 7,000），或两者并罚（s.30(1)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Notwithstanding that a licence has been granted under section 20, no person shall use, in relation to any article or process, the Standard Mark or any colourable imitation thereof unless such article or process conforms to the Bangladesh Standard.
rules.notes: 需核对具体 BDS 版本与检测报告；许可证存在不等于持续符合。

rules.law_name: The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No. XXXVII of 1985) 孟加拉国标准与检验机构法令 1985
rules.requirement: 政府可在与 BSTI 协商后，以公报通知禁止销售、分销和商业广告不符合相应 BDS 的指定商品；通知生效日不得早于公布后两个月。
rules.evidence_needed: 适用 SRO/公报通知、产品是否在名单内、BDS 符合性证据（检测报告/CM 证书）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.24 通知：最高监禁 4 年或罚金 Taka 100,000（最低 Taka 7,000），或两者并罚（s.31A）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Government may, in consultation with the Institution, by notification in the official Gazette, prohibit with effect from such date as may be specified in the notification, the sale, distribution and commercial advertisement of any article specified therein which does not conform to the Bangladesh Standard established by the Institution in relation to that article
rules.notes: s.24(1) 的英文文本含 2003 年修正的方括号；本引文取修正后的 operative wording。商业广告被明确纳入禁止范围。

rules.law_name: The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No. XXXVII of 1985) 孟加拉国标准与检验机构法令 1985
rules.requirement: 政府可以公报通知要求符合特定 BDS 的商品加贴标准标志。
rules.evidence_needed: 公报通知、BDS 号、标签/包装照片、CM 证书。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.24 通知：s.31A（最高 4 年/10 万塔卡）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, require any article which conforms to a particular Bangladesh Standard to be marked with the Standard Mark.
rules.notes: 本条是授权条款；具体商品是否被要求加贴，需查对应公报通知。

rules.law_name: The Bangladesh Standards and Testing Institution Ordinance, 1985 (Ordinance No. XXXVII of 1985) 孟加拉国标准与检验机构法令 1985
rules.requirement: 商品本身、其包装或所附标签带有标准标志的，即视为该商品已加贴标准标志；标志可以落在包装或标签上。
rules.evidence_needed: 实物/包装/标签照片、标志位置、许可证号。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不适用（定义条款）；违反使用规则依 s.19/s.30。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: An article is said to be marked with a Standard Mark if the article itself is marked with Standard Mark, or any covering containing, or label attached to, such article is so marked.
rules.notes: 定义条款，用于判断标志是否‘出现’，不单独创设处罚。

rules.law_name: BSTI Mandatory Certification Marks List (315 products, 2025) BSTI 强制认证标志产品清单（315 项，2025）
rules.requirement: 在孟加拉国销售、分销或商业广告家用电热水壶前，该产品的制造商/进口商须取得 BSTI 认证标志（CM）许可并符合 BDS 253:1990；该产品列于 BSTI 315 项强制认证清单第 310 项。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、BDS 253:1990 检测报告、标签/包装照片、型号与清单对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 CM 许可或不符合 BDS：BSTI Ordinance s.19/s.24/s.30/s.31A；罚则为上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 310. Electric kettles for domestic use (first revision) BDS 253:1990
rules.notes: 清单为 BSTI 英文汇总表（2025-06-03），底层 SRO 为孟加拉文；具体型号/范围需以 SRO 与 BSTI 许可为准。

rules.law_name: BSTI Mandatory Certification Marks List (315 products, 2025) BSTI 强制认证标志产品清单（315 项，2025）
rules.requirement: 在孟加拉国销售、分销或商业广告家用电熨斗前，该产品的制造商/进口商须取得 BSTI 认证标志（CM）许可并符合 BDS IEC 60311:2018；该产品列于 BSTI 315 项强制认证清单第 285 项。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、BDS IEC 60311:2018 检测报告、标签/包装照片、型号与清单对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 CM 许可或不符合 BDS：BSTI Ordinance s.19/s.24/s.30/s.31A；罚则为上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 285. Electric irons for household or similar use – Methods for measuring performance BDS IEC 60311:2018
rules.notes: 清单为 BSTI 英文汇总表（2025-06-03），底层 SRO 为孟加拉文；具体型号/范围需以 SRO 与 BSTI 许可为准。

rules.law_name: BSTI Mandatory Certification Marks List (315 products, 2025) BSTI 强制认证标志产品清单（315 项，2025）
rules.requirement: 在孟加拉国销售、分销或商业广告家用电风扇及其调节器前，该产品的制造商/进口商须取得 BSTI 认证标志（CM）许可并符合 BDS 818:1998（含 Amendment 1:2006）；该产品列于 BSTI 315 项强制认证清单第 269 项。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、BDS 818:1998 检测报告、标签/包装照片、型号与清单对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 CM 许可或不符合 BDS：BSTI Ordinance s.19/s.24/s.30/s.31A；罚则为上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 269. Performance and construction of electric circulating fans and regulators BDS 818: 1998 (1st revision) Amendment 1:2006
rules.notes: 清单为 BSTI 英文汇总表（2025-06-03），底层 SRO 为孟加拉文；具体型号/范围需以 SRO 与 BSTI 许可为准。

rules.law_name: BSTI Mandatory Certification Marks List (315 products, 2025) BSTI 强制认证标志产品清单（315 项，2025）
rules.requirement: 在孟加拉国销售、分销或商业广告家用微波炉前，该产品的制造商/进口商须取得 BSTI 认证标志（CM）许可并符合 BDS IEC 60705:2008；该产品列于 BSTI 315 项强制认证清单第 305 项。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、BDS IEC 60705:2008 检测报告、标签/包装照片、型号与清单对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 CM 许可或不符合 BDS：BSTI Ordinance s.19/s.24/s.30/s.31A；罚则为上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 305. Household microwave ovens – Methods for measuring performance BDS IEC 60705:2008
rules.notes: 清单为 BSTI 英文汇总表（2025-06-03），底层 SRO 为孟加拉文；具体型号/范围需以 SRO 与 BSTI 许可为准。

rules.law_name: BSTI Mandatory Certification Marks List (315 products, 2025) BSTI 强制认证标志产品清单（315 项，2025）
rules.requirement: 在孟加拉国销售、分销或商业广告一次电池（含 AA/AAA、锂电、纽扣电池等）前，该产品的制造商/进口商须取得 BSTI 认证标志（CM）许可并符合 BDS IEC 60086 系列（Part 1-5:2019）；该产品列于 BSTI 315 项强制认证清单第 284 项。
rules.evidence_needed: BSTI CM 许可证号/证书、BDS IEC 60086 系列检测报告、标签/包装照片、型号与清单对应关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未取得 CM 许可或不符合 BDS：BSTI Ordinance s.19/s.24/s.30/s.31A；罚则为上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 284. Primary Batteries – Part 1: General BDS IEC 60086 (Part 1):2019
rules.notes: 清单第 284 项涵盖 Part 1-5；引文只摘 Part 1。充电电池/移动电源是否另属其他标准，需按型号核对。

rules.law_name: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930 (Act No. III of 1930) 货物销售法 1930
rules.requirement: 以说明方式销售商品时，商品必须与说明相符；若同时凭样品销售，仅大货与样品相符还不够，还必须与说明相符。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页描述、规格书、实物/检测报告；差异需可核对。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济（损害赔偿/拒收等），非 CRPA 刑事罚则；具体救济依合同与法院判断。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where there is a contract for the sale of goods by description, there is an implied condition that the goods shall correspond with the description; and, if the sale is by sample as well as by description, it is not sufficient that the bulk of the goods corresponds with the sample if the goods do not also correspond with the description.
rules.notes: 民事默示条件，不是行政认证规则；用于‘描述与实物不符’的观察线索。

rules.law_name: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930 (Act No. III of 1930) 货物销售法 1930
rules.requirement: 若买家明示或默示让卖家知悉特定用途并依赖卖家技能/判断，且该商品属卖家经营范围内，则存在‘合理适合该用途’的默示条件；特定商品按专利/商品名销售时除外。
rules.evidence_needed: 用途说明、买家沟通、卖家专业性、测试报告；需合同语境。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济；非刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where the buyer, expressly or by implication, makes known to the seller the particular purpose for which the goods are required, so as to show that the buyer relies on the seller's skill or judgment, and the goods are of a description which it is in the course of the seller's business to supply (whether he is the manufacturer or producer or not), there is an implied condition that the goods shall be reasonably fit for such purpose:
rules.notes: 需合同与用途语境；不能仅凭页面‘suitable for’字样判定。

rules.law_name: The Sale of Goods Act, 1930 (Act No. III of 1930) 货物销售法 1930
rules.requirement: 若商品凭说明从经营该类商品的卖家处购买，则存在‘商销品质’的默示条件；买家已检验的商品，对检验应能发现的缺陷不适用。
rules.evidence_needed: 验收/检验记录、缺陷证据、行业标准；需合同语境。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济；非刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where goods are bought by description from a seller who deals in goods of that description (whether he is the manufacturer or producer or not), there is an implied condition that the goods shall be of merchantable quality:
rules.notes: ‘merchantable quality’无统一数值标准，需结合价格、描述与行业惯例；属人工判断。
